toast.title: Installation successful
toast.description: You can now set up and use the reader.

bridgeWarning.title: Prepare the GL.iNet GL-S10
bridgeWarning.power: Never power the GL-S10 through USB and PoE at the same time.
bridgeWarning.wiring: Open the case and connect a 3.3 V USB-TTL adapter to the serial pads: TX to RX, RX to TX, GND to GND and 3.3 V to 3.3 V. Never use a 5 V adapter.
bridgeWarning.downloadMode: Hold the download button (GPIO0) while you power the GL-S10 up, then start the installation.
bridgeWarning.docsLink: Step-by-step guide to the pads and wiring

powerCycle.title: Restart the bridge
powerCycle.description: The firmware is installed. The bridge cannot be restarted automatically: switch its power off and on again without holding GPIO0, and keep the USB-TTL adapter connected. Then continue with the PIN, network and server settings over the same connection.

chipMismatch.title: Wrong chip for this firmware
chipMismatch.description: This firmware is built for {{expected}}, but the connected device is an {{detected}}. Nothing was installed. Choose the firmware for this device.
